judge_context: A Zig project with build.zig setting the x86-64-v3 target, a thin C-ABI layer that dispatches on (src_fmt, dst_fmt, algo) to kernels chosen in swscale_create, and kernels grouped by family (YUV<->RGB, packed swizzles, chroma (de)interleave, horizontal/vertical scalers) that share generic @Vector helpers rather than 58 copy-pasted loops. Coefficient tables and fixed-point constants are documented with their FFmpeg counterparts; no dead experimental kernels or debug prints left.

case_items.name: Geometry, stride and tail handling
case_items.name_zh: 几何尺寸、步长与尾部处理
case_items.question: Do the conversion and scaling kernels handle arbitrary frame sizes (tails not divisible by the SIMD width, tiny and odd-width frames, up- and down-scaling) and honour strides larger than the row size on every plane, returning NULL from swscale_create for unsupported configurations?

criteria.perfect: SIMD kernels have scalar (or masked) tails for widths not divisible by the vector width; src/dst strides larger than the row size are honoured for every plane; up- and down-scaling, very small (e.g. 2x2) and odd-width packed/444 frames work; chroma siting/rounding follows FFmpeg; swscale_create returns NULL for unsupported format/algo combinations instead of crashing.
criteria.accept: General case correct; one class (e.g. tiny frames or a rarely used format pair) relies on an assumption that the contract happens to satisfy.
criteria.bad: Assumes width is a multiple of the vector width or stride == width, or hard-codes the contract frame sizes, so other geometries read/write out of bounds or produce wrong pixels.

case_items.name: ABI and build-target conformance
case_items.name_zh: ABI 与构建目标符合要求
case_items.question: Does the library export exactly the three C-ABI functions of /app/swscale_api.h with matching signatures and return conventions, built single-threaded for x86-64-v3 as configured in build.zig?

criteria.perfect: Exports exactly swscale_create / swscale_process / swscale_destroy with C linkage and the header's signatures; swscale_process returns 0 on success; precomputation lives in swscale_create; the target (x86-64-v3, no AVX-512) is set in build.zig, not on the command line; no ff_-prefixed symbols; single-threaded.
criteria.accept: ABI correct, but a minor deviation (extra exported helper symbols, target set in a way that still yields x86-64-v3) is present.
criteria.bad: Signature/linkage mismatch, AVX-512 or host-native target, threads spawned in swscale_process, or the build depends on command-line flags the verifier does not pass.
